questions.question: How can you reduce fatigue while driving?
questions.explanation: Taking frequent rest breaks during a long trip helps reduce fatigue. Caffeine can make fatigue worse when it wears off. Bad weather can also increase fatigue, so dress warmly and protect yourself from wind and rain.

questions.question: When a crash happens, a rider wearing a helmet is:

options.text: Less likely to survive than a rider without a helmet.
Just as likely to survive as a rider without a helmet.
More likely to survive than a rider without a helmet.

questions.correctAnswerText: More likely to survive than a rider without a helmet.
questions.explanation: Riders without helmets are three times more likely to die from head injuries than riders wearing helmets during a crash, regardless of speed.

questions.question: The best way to handle a tailgater is to:
questions.explanation: The best way to deal with a tailgater is to let them pass. Speeding up will only cause them to tailgate you at a higher speed, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: If your motorcycle weaves while riding over rain grooves or bridge gratings, you should:

options.text: Speed up to cross the surface faster.
Exaggerate the zigzag motion to alert other drivers.
Keep a steady speed and ride straight across.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep a steady speed and ride straight across.
questions.explanation: If your motorcycle weaves on grooves or gratings, maintain a steady speed and go straight across the surface. Zigzagging to stay in your lane is more dangerous.

questions.question: When riding in a group, riders should:

options.text: Follow each other as closely as possible.
Not worry about distances between members.

questions.explanation: When riding in a group, use a staggered formation. This allows riders to stay close together while maintaining safe following distances.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Focus only on what is in front of you.
Focus only on what is behind you.
Be aware of what is both in front of and behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be aware of what is both in front of and behind you.
questions.explanation: While it is most important to watch the road ahead, you must also watch what is behind you. Check your mirrors regularly to stay aware of traffic behind you.

questions.question: Should you wear gloves while riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Yes. Your hands may get cold while riding.
Yes. They improve your grip and protect your hands.
No. Gloves interfere with the controls.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes. They improve your grip and protect your hands.
questions.explanation: Wearing gloves improves your grip and protects your hands. Use full-fingered gloves made of durable material.

questions.question: What removes alcohol from your system?
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol from your system. No other method can speed up this process.

questions.question: Traffic lanes moving in the same direction are separated by:
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Solid lines mean no passing. Dashed lines mean passing is allowed if it is safe.

questions.question: When a motorcyclist needs to stop quickly, they should:

options.text: Apply both brakes at the same time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Apply both brakes at the same time.
questions.explanation: To stop quickly, apply both brakes at the same time. Look ahead to avoid the need for sudden stops.

questions.question: When entering a turn, you should:

options.text: Take the motorcycle out of gear.

questions.explanation: Change gears before you enter a turn. If you must change gears while turning, do it smoothly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with red and black markings. They tell drivers what traffic laws apply in that area. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: When slowing or stopping a motorcycle, you should:
questions.explanation: Shift down through the gears as you slow or stop. Stay in first gear when stopped so you can move quickly if needed.

questions.question: When buying a motorcycle helmet, your main concern should be:
questions.explanation: Protection is the most important thing to consider when buying a motorcycle helmet.

questions.question: When traveling at night, judging distances is:

options.text: About the same as during the day.

questions.explanation: It is harder to judge distances at night than during the day. Shadows and light help you see how far away objects are. At night, artificial lights may distort or hide these clues.

questions.question: As your motorcycle speed increases, you will:

options.text: Need to shift up through the gears.
Need to shift down through the gears.
Need to put the motorcycle into neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Need to shift up through the gears.
questions.explanation: You must shift into higher gears as your motorcycle goes faster.

questions.question: For a passenger, a helmet is:

options.text: Only required if the operator wears one.

questions.explanation: In Virginia, both motorcycle operators and passengers must wear helmets. A proper helmet is your best protection against head and neck injuries in a crash.

questions.question: The front brake:

options.text: Should only be used in emergencies.
Should be used with the rear brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be used with the rear brake.
questions.explanation: Always use both brakes when you slow down or stop.

questions.question: What should you do when borrowing a motorcycle?

options.text: Assume the controls are in the same places as on your motorcycle.
Take it out on the highway right away.
Practice with it in a safe, controlled area first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Practice with it in a safe, controlled area first.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before riding a borrowed motorcycle, learn where all the controls are. Practice in a safe area before riding on the road.

questions.question: What is the only way to become sober after drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time allows your body to remove alcohol from your system. Coffee and exercise cannot speed up this process.

questions.question: What is the best footwear for motorcycle riders?
questions.explanation: Leather boots protect your feet best while riding. Choose boots that are high and strong enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: What lane position should you choose?

options.text: One that helps you avoid road hazards.
One that hides you from other drivers.
One that places you right next to another vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: One that helps you avoid road hazards.
questions.explanation: Choose a lane position that helps you stay away from road hazards. Always keep safe space around your motorcycle.

questions.question: What colors should motorcycle riders wear?
questions.explanation: Bright colors like orange, red, yellow, and green make riders easier for other drivers to see on the road.
